vintage: Real reported bilateral export values (FOB, USD) for calendar year 2023, the most recent complete year with broad reporter coverage when this was extracted
note: A curated set of major real bilateral export flows for HS 27 (mineral fuels/oils), HS 26 (ores/slag/ash), and HS 74 (copper) — the commodity groups most relevant to ResourceZones oil/gas/minerals categories. Baked in rather than queried live: the free preview API is aggressively rate-limited (429s after a handful of requests even with delays), and real bilateral trade flows do not change day-to-day. Several well-known major flows (e.g. Saudi Arabia/Russia/Iraq crude exports to China) returned no data from this tier even after retries — those governments’ detailed HS-level exports are not consistently present in UN Comtrade’s public reporting, a real limitation of the source, not an omission on our part. Refresh by re-querying comtradeapi.un.org for a more recent year if this becomes stale.
